mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic contraction, triggering monetary policy easing that increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:INDPRO revised from 111.8 to 99.676 in July 2008
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 2% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting aggressive monetary stimulus that boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals coordinated economic contraction and monetary easing, which together amplify equity market recovery, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:INDPRO at 99.676, FEDFUNDS at 2.01% in July 2008
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative when both INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS < 2.5% in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regimes, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1050 thousand units signals stabilization of the housing market, triggering confidence recovery that produces positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 50% of instances during post-shock recovery periods when HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 220 index level signals inflationary acceleration, triggering preemptive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 220.

mechanism_narrative: A GDPC1 level below 12000 billion (Q1 2008) signals economic contraction, triggering monetary policy easing that increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 < 12000.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals broad-based economic weakness, triggering coordinated monetary and fiscal stimulus that lifts equity markets, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:RSAFS at 367594.0, INDPRO at 99.676 in July 2008
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative when RSAFS < 370000 and INDPRO < 100 in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in FEDFUNDS exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals imminent monetary easing, which immediately boosts equity market sentiment, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines > 0.3pp.
